title: Aye Bekafan Hussain gareebul watan
body:
aye bekafan hussain gharibul watan hussain
1. ummat ne khoob ajr-e-risalat adaa kiyaa
pammal teri laash ko bad-e-qaza kiya
uriya badan hussain gharibul watan
hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
2. soti thi sada laqte jigar tujhko sulakar
chakki bhi jo pisy hain to godi mein litakar
tashna dahan hussain gharibul watan
husain
<<DIVIDER>>
3. ayi na kabhi lal tujhe dhoop mein lekar
ab tabti zamee par hain tera lasha-e-besir
aye gulbadan hussain gharibul watan
hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
4. masroor kaam agaya giriya yeh qaber mein
aye kaash labpe ho mera nauha ye hashar
mein
aye bekafan hussain gharibul watan . . .
